profile_text: With 53 employees as of 2024, representing a 43.2% growth since the baseline, this Rhine shipping company has established itself as a significant player in the transportation and storage sector. Founded over 200 years ago, its extensive experience in river transportation has enabled it to scale efficiently, earning it a "Scaler" category designation. As it approaches its 200th anniversary in 2026, the company continues to build on its legacy, leveraging its expertise to drive growth and expansion in the industry.
